[[File:Susannah Dy MTN Haus.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Susannah Dy, MTN Haus leadership photo.]]
'''Susannah Dy''' hosted the Dune Sea and Beggar's Canyon rooms at the 14 March 1997 [[Star Wars CCG Palace]] Grand Opening party, and explained the Palace zap and blast features.<ref name="party">[http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Special Events], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327205534/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>
